records.context: The existing shuffle method only raises the entered scale until its call-rate check passes. Never calibration measures wrong library calls from substitution-control opportunities and may lower or raise the scale, with a floor of one. Both methods use this loop and the same threshold tuner. A repeated never setting ends the loop; a cycle keeps the larger tested cycling scale and its matching threshold result. The report half is held out from never calibration.

records.translation: Núverandi shuffle-aðferð hækkar aðeins innsleginn kvarða þar til prófun hennar á kallatíðni stenst. records.context: The N2 call rate per distance-two opportunity predicts wrong library calls at that distance. Libraries containing distance-one guide pairs also contribute the N1 rate times their distance-one opportunities. The expected wrong calls times k, divided by the observed decoy calls, give the scale. A zero decoy sum uses ``_AUTO_ZERO_DECOYS``, as the existing threshold tuner does. With ci, the chosen scale is the upper end of the 95 percent field bootstrap, using the existing row sampler. Clipping the chosen scale to one belongs to ``calibrate_fdr_scale``.
records.label: spacr.ops_decode.never_scale#1
records.source: The N2 call rate per distance-two opportunity predicts wrong library calls at that distance. Libraries containing distance-one guide pairs also contribute the N1 rate times their distance-one opportunities. The expected wrong calls times k, divided by the observed decoy calls, give the scale. A zero decoy sum uses ``_AUTO_ZERO_DECOYS``, as the existing threshold tuner does. With ci, the chosen scale is the upper end of the 95 percent field bootstrap, using the existing row sampler. Clipping the chosen scale to one belongs to ``calibrate_fdr_scale``.
records.translation: N2-kallatíðni á hvern möguleika á kalli í fjarlægð tvö spáir fyrir um röng köll á merki í safninu í þeirri fjarlægð. Söfn sem innihalda pör leiðsögumerkja í fjarlægð eitt leggja einnig til N1-tíðnina margfaldaða með möguleikum þeirra á köllum í fjarlægð eitt. Kvarðinn fæst með því að margfalda væntan fjölda rangra kalla með k og deila með þeim fjölda tálbeitukalla sem mældist. Ef samanlagður fjöldi tálbeitukalla er núll er ``_AUTO_ZERO_DECOYS`` notað, eins og í núverandi þröskuldastillingu. Með ci er valinn kvarði efri mörk 95 prósenta bootstrap-bils yfir sjónsvið, með núverandi úrtaksvali raða. Það er hlutverk ``calibrate_fdr_scale`` að takmarka valinn kvarða við að minnsta kosti einn.
